name: Love To Live
source:
You wake up with no clue where you are. When you finally get face-to-face with your captor, he reveals to you that you have two choices: convince him that you're in love or forfeit your life.

[From [url=https://theartofgaming.itch.io/lovetolive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时不知道自己在哪里。当你最终与绑架者面对面时，他向你透露你有两个选择：让他相信你恋爱了，或者放弃自己的生命。

[来自[url=https://theartofgaming.itch.io/lovetolive]itch.io[/url]]
